installedHelp: Skills are folders with a SKILL.md file that tell coding agents (e.g. Codex) how to do a task. Here you see the installed skills, read the SKILL.md file of a skill, and delete a skill.
findHelp: Skills are folders with a SKILL.md file that tell coding agents (e.g. Codex) how to do a task. Here you find a skill on skills.sh, in a folder on this computer, or in a folder on GitHub or GitLab, read the SKILL.md file of the skill before you install it, and install it for the user or for the workspace.
levelHelp: Where a new skill is installed
searchHelp: Type a word. The search starts when you stop typing.
folderHelp: The folder of one skill (it holds the file SKILL.md), or a folder whose subfolders each hold one skill.
folderChooseTitle: Choose the folder of the skill
addressHelp: A folder on GitHub or GitLab: the folder of one skill (it holds the file SKILL.md), or a folder whose subfolders each hold one skill.
differentTitle: The SKILL.md file of this skill is not the same as the file of the installed skill. Click Inspect to see what differs.
differenceTitle: Show what differs between the installed skill and this skill
differenceHelp: Lines with − are only in the installed skill. Lines with + are only in this skill. Only the SKILL.md file is compared.
differenceNone: This skill has the same SKILL.md file as the installed skill.
installTitleWorkspace: Install in the folder of the workspace
installTitleReplace: Replace the installed skill with this one (the installed skill moves to the Trash)
infoNoDescription: This skill has no description in its SKILL.md file.
infoUnreadable: The SKILL.md file of this skill could not be read.
infoInstalled: This skill is installed at the chosen level, with the same SKILL.md file.
infoInstalledDifferent: A skill with this name is installed at the chosen level, with another SKILL.md file.
sourceTitle: Show the source of the file, with colours
noAgent: No coding agent is switched on. Switch one on in the section Agents to install skills.
addLinkTitle: Make this skill available to {agent}, with a link to the real folder
help_level_what_text: The place where Heidrun Code puts the new skill.
help_level_user_text: The skill goes in the home folder of the developer. Every workspace can use it.
help_level_workspace_text: The skill goes in the folder of the selected workspace. Only this workspace can use it.
help_level_agents_text: Heidrun Code installs the skill for each coding agent that is switched on in the section Agents.
help_source_label: About the source of the skill
help_source_what_text: The place where Heidrun Code finds the skill. The choice changes the field below.
help_source_skills_sh_text: A search in the public list of skills.
help_source_code_hosting_text: A folder on GitHub or GitLab, given as a web address.
help_search_what_text: Words to look for in the public list of skills on skills.sh.
help_search_sent_text: Heidrun Code sends the words that you type to the website skills.sh.
help_search_how_text: The search starts when you stop typing. Each result shows its number of installs.
help_folder_label: About the folder of the skill
help_folder_what_text: A folder on this computer. It is the folder of one skill (it holds the file SKILL.md), or a folder whose subfolders each hold the file SKILL.md. Type the full path, or choose the folder with the button.
help_folder_does_text: Heidrun Code lists every skill that it finds, one row for each skill. When you install a row, Heidrun Code copies the files of that skill to the installation level. Nothing is sent over the network.
help_folder_no_file_title: When there is no file SKILL.md
help_folder_no_file_text: The folder and its subfolders have no file SKILL.md. The window shows an error message, and no result.
help_address_title: Web address of the skill folder
help_address_label: About the web address of the skill folder
help_address_what_text: The web address of the page that GitHub or GitLab shows for a folder. It is the folder of one skill (it holds the file SKILL.md), or a folder whose subfolders each hold the file SKILL.md. The window lists every skill that it finds, one row for each skill.
help_address_sent_text: 500 milliseconds after your last key, Heidrun Code asks GitHub or GitLab for the list of the files below the folder. The repository must be public.
help_address_fails_text: A private repository or a missing folder gives an error message.
help_result_what_text: The skill that Heidrun Code found, with its name and its source.
help_result_inspect_text: Shows the file SKILL.md of the skill, so that you can read it before the installation.
help_result_install_text: Installs the skill at the chosen installation level. The row then shows Installed.
